dedupe_keys.name: china crop emissions rice cultivation uncertainty sample code

description: This Figshare software item provides a small MATLAB example for treating uncertainty in rice-cultivation greenhouse gas estimates within the China cropping-system inventory. Its own page lists one source file and states CC0. A modeller could inspect the calculation when propagating a similar emission-factor uncertainty into a crop or rural-energy scenario. It is an example for one activity, not a complete inventory generator for all provinces and years. The required input structure and statistical assumptions need checking before reuse; the code was not run here. I read its repository metadata and the Scientific Data description without opening the source file. The related emissions collection contains the published point estimates and intervals as separate data items. No exact catalogue software record was found. The example covers rice cultivation only and does not reproduce all seven activity groups in the companion inventory.
